62823-reveries-of-a-bachelor-or-a-book-o.title: A Book of the Heart
62823-reveries-of-a-bachelor-or-a-book-o.creator: Ik Marvel
62823-reveries-of-a-bachelor-or-a-book-o.description: A book by Ik Marvel. I HAVE got a quiet farmhouse in the country, a very humble place to be sure, tenanted by a worthy enough man, of the old New England stamp, where I sometimes go for a day or two in the winter, to look over the farm accounts, and to see how the stock is thriving on the winter’s keep.

arxiv-2011-05024.title: Hopf Galois module structure of dihedral degree 2 ​ p 2p extensions of ℚ p {\mathbb{Q}}_{p}
arxiv-2011-05024.creator: Daniel Gil-Muñoz, Anna Rio
arxiv-2011-05024.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Daniel Gil-Muñoz, Anna Rio. Let p p be an odd prime. For field extensions L / ℚ p L/{\mathbb{Q}}_{p} with Galois group isomorphic to the dihedral group D 2 ​ p D_{2p} of order 2 ​ p 2p , we consider the problem of computing a basis of the associated order in each Hopf Galois structure and the module structure of the ring of integers 𝒪 L \mathcal{O}_{L} .

arxiv-2201-00581.title: Casimir interactions from infinite range and dilation symmetry
arxiv-2201-00581.creator: Venkat Abhignan, R. Sankaranarayanan
arxiv-2201-00581.description: Abstract The Casimir interaction energy for a class of discrete self-similar configuration of parallel plates is evaluated using existing methods. The similarities to characteristics of an attractive Casimir force is deduced only at infinite range of configuration. Further, the emergence of Casimir-like energy is qualitatively described for a Gaussian model of Landau-Ginzburg scalar field.

arxiv-2211-02629.title: Multi-view Multi-label Fine-grained Emotion Decoding from Human Brain Activity
arxiv-2211-02629.creator: Kaicheng Fu, Changde Du, Shengpei Wang, Huiguang He
arxiv-2211-02629.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kaicheng Fu, Changde Du, Shengpei Wang, Huiguang He. Decoding emotional states from human brain activity plays an important role in brain-computer interfaces. Existing emotion decoding methods still have two main limitations: one is only decoding a single emotion category from a brain activity pattern and the decoded emotion categories are coarse-grained, which is inconsistent with the complex emotional expression of human; the other is ignoring the discrepancy of emotion expression between the left and right hemispheres of human brain.

arxiv-2411-07439.title: Music Discovery Dialogue Generation Using Human Intent Analysis and Large Language Models
arxiv-2411-07439.description: Abstract A conversational music retrieval system can help users discover music that matches their preferences through dialogue. To achieve this, a conversational music retrieval system should seamlessly engage in multi-turn conversation by 1) understanding user queries and 2) responding with natural language and retrieved music. A straightforward solution would be a data-driven approach utilizing such conversation logs.

arxiv-2502-01429.title: An Algorithm for Fixed Budget Best Arm Identification with Combinatorial Exploration
arxiv-2502-01429.creator: Siddhartha Parupudi, Gourab Ghatak
arxiv-2502-01429.description: Abstract We consider the best arm identification (BAI) problem in the K − K- armed bandit framework with a modification - the agent is allowed to play a subset of arms at each time slot instead of one arm. Consequently, the agent observes the sample average of the rewards of the arms that constitute the probed subset.

arxiv-2502-20297.title: Moderate-length lifted quantum Tanner codes
arxiv-2502-20297.creator: Virgile Guemard, Gilles Zemor
arxiv-2502-20297.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Virgile Guemard, Gilles Zemor. We introduce new families of quantum Tanner codes, a class of quantum codes which first appeared in the work of Leverrier and Zémor [ 11 ] . These codes are built from two classical Tanner codes, for which the underlying graphs are extracted from coverings of 2D geometrical complexes, and the local linear codes are tensor-product of cyclic or double-circulant linear codes.

arxiv-2503-05420.title: Cavity-mediated charge and pair-density waves in a unitary Fermi gas
arxiv-2503-05420.creator: T. Zwettler, F. Marijanovic, T. Bühler, S. Chattopadhyay, G. Del Pace, L. Skolc, V. Helson, S. Uchino, E. Demler, J.P. Brantut
arxiv-2503-05420.description: Abstract Coherent light-matter interactions between a quantum gas and light in a high-finesse cavity can drive self-ordering phase transitions. To date, such phenomena have involved exclusively single-atom coupling to light, resulting in coupled charge-density or spin-density wave and superradiant order.

arxiv-2504-05096.title: Cooperation guides evolution in a minimal model of biological evolution.
arxiv-2504-05096.creator: Conor Houghton [0000-0001-5017-9473]
arxiv-2504-05096.description: Abstract A challenging simulation of evolutionary dynamics based on a three-state cellular automaton is used as a test of how cooperation can drive the evolution of complex traits. Building on the approach of Wolfram (2025), the fitness of a cellular automaton is determined by the number of updates it endures before returning to an empty configuration.

arxiv-2505-04335.title: Hyperbolic Fuzzy C-Means with Adaptive Weight-based Filtering for Efficient Clustering
arxiv-2505-04335.creator: Swagato Das ∗, Arghya Pratihar ∗, Swagatam Das
arxiv-2505-04335.description: Abstract Clustering algorithms play a pivotal role in unsupervised learning by identifying and grouping similar objects based on shared characteristics. Although traditional clustering techniques, such as hard and fuzzy center-based clustering, have been widely used, they struggle with complex, high-dimensional, and non-Euclidean datasets.

arxiv-2506-21489.title: Observers and Timekeepers: From the Page-Wootters
arxiv-2506-21489.creator: Mechanism to the Gravitational Path Integral
arxiv-2506-21489.description: Abstract Quantum gravity in a closed universe faces two a priori distinct yet seemingly related issues: the problem of time and the fact that its Hilbert space dimension is one. Both have been argued to be resolvable by formulating physics relative to an observer.

arxiv-2508-11585.title: Lower Bounds for Induced-Universal Graphs
arxiv-2508-11585.creator: Cyril Gavoille, Amaury Jacques
arxiv-2508-11585.description: Abstract We give a series of new lower bounds on the minimum number of vertices required by a graph to contain every graph of a given family as induced subgraph. In particular, we show that this induced-universal graph for n n -vertex planar graphs must have at least 10.52 ​ n 10.52n vertices.

arxiv-2606-01350.creator: Chinmay K. Mohanty, Kacper Walczyk, Tomasz Woźniak, Chengcheng Jiang, Adam Babiński, Clement Faugeras, Zhaolong Chen, Maciej R. Molas

doe-osti-3377650-energy-101-solar-slides.title: Energy 101: Solar [Slides]
doe-osti-3377650-energy-101-solar-slides.creator: Crouse, Maddy
doe-osti-3377650-energy-101-solar-slides.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The Energy 101: Solar presentation, developed for the Energy Technology Innovation Partnership Project (ETIPP), provides an overview of solar energy. It covers fundamental concepts, designs, solar for different scales and use cases, and additional resources.

pmc-10515402.title: Analysis of the Structure, Thermal, and Molecular Dynamics of Organic–Inorganic Hybrid Crystal at Phases IV, III, II, and I: [NH2(CH3)2]2CdBr4
pmc-10515402.creator: Sun Ha Kim, Yong Lak Joo, Ae Ran Lim
pmc-10515402.description: A comprehensive understanding of the physicochemical properties of organic–inorganic hybrids is essential for their solid-state lighting applications. Therefore, a single crystal of [NH2(CH3)2]2CdBr4 was grown; the crystal structure was monoclinic, and the phase transition temperatures for the four phases IV, III, II, and I were 383 K (TC1), 417 K (TC2), and 427 K (TC3).

pmc-11726865.title: The Role of Regulatory B Lymphocytes in Allergic Diseases
pmc-11726865.creator: Agnieszka Lipińska-Opałka, Michalina Leszczyńska-Pilich, Agata Będzichowska, Agata Tomaszewska, Agnieszka Rustecka, Bolesław Kalicki, Carmen Panaitescu
pmc-11726865.description: Purpose of review: Regulatory B cells (Bregs) are a key component in the regulation of the immune system. Their immunosuppressive function, which includes limiting the inflammatory cascade, occurs through interactions with other immune cells and the secretion of cytokines, primarily IL-10.

pmc-12360994.title: Antibacterial activity of promising nanostructured cesium oxide
pmc-12360994.creator: Wedam Alghazzawi
pmc-12360994.description: As bacterial strains become increasingly resistant to antibiotics, many researchers are seeking novel, effective, and inexpensive antibiotics. Some nanomaterials have been suggested as potential candidates for use as novel antibacterial agents. In this study, cesium oxide nanoparticles were synthesized and preliminarily investigated for their ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria.

pmc-12429967.title: Organic Field-Effect Transistors Based on Chemical-Plated Pt/Ag Electrodes
pmc-12429967.creator: Chenyang Zhao, Xiaochen Ren
pmc-12429967.description: In this study, we successfully prepared silver electrodes through a silver mirror reaction. By carefully regulating the amount of ammonia complexing agent in the silver–ammonia solution, we effectively suppressed the decomposition of the plating solution while reducing the surface roughness of silver films from 9.22 nm to 4.42 nm.

pmc-13407467.title: Analysis of Clinical, Biopsychosocial Factors and Mmp3 Polymorphism in Women with TMD
pmc-13407467.creator: Ian Luna Parente Brasileiro, Francisca Katiana De Oliveira Feitosa Donato, Paulo Henrique Couto Souza, Luciana Reis Azevedo Alanis, Luis Eduardo Almeida, Andrea Duarte Doetzer, Paula Cristina Trevilatto
pmc-13407467.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objectives: Temporomandibular disorder (TMD) is a multifactorial condition that significantly affects patients’ quality of life. This study investigated the association between clinical, biopsychosocial, and genetic factors, including the MMP3 rs679620 polymorphism, and TMD in women from southern Brazil. Methods: A cross-sectional case–control study was conducted including 305 women, comprising 138 patients with TMD (disc displacement with or without reduction and arthralgia) and 167 controls without TMD symptoms. TMD was diagnosed according to the Research Diagnostic Criteria for Temporomandibular Disorders (RDC/TMD).

pmc-13411828.title: Acid-Induced Epimerization of Eudesmin to Epieudesmin: Rapid Bactericidal and Antibiofilm Activity Against Helicobacter pylori
pmc-13411828.creator: Cristian Parra-Sepúlveda, Kimberly Sánchez-Alonzo, José Becerra, Leandro Ortiz, Viviana Burgos, Cecilia Villegas, Felipe A. Sanhueza, Benjamín Oporto, Cristobal Goic, Apolinaria García-Cancino, Cristian Paz
pmc-13411828.description: Helicobacter pylori infection is associated with severe gastroduodenal pathologies. This study evaluated the bactericidal and antibiofilm activities of eudesmin, a furanofuran lignan from Araucaria araucana, and its acid-induced epimer, epieudesmin, against clinical isolates and the H. pylori ATCC 43504 strain. Virulence profiles and antibiotic susceptibility (CLSI/EUCAST) were determined.

pmc-13615329.title: Differential Demographic Trajectories and Polygenic Adaptation to Monsoon Seasonality in Sky Island Hercules Beetle Populations of the American Southwest
pmc-13615329.creator: Sean Chien, My‐Hanh Le, Heath Blackmon, Jen‐Pan Huang
pmc-13615329.description: Sky island mountain ranges of the American Southwest represent isolated habitat fragments surrounded by arid lowland barriers, making them powerful natural experiments for studying population divergence, demographic history and local adaptation. Here, we use whole‐genome resequencing of the Western Hercules beetle (Dynastes grantii Horn, 1870) across four primary lineages to characterize the genomic consequences of habitat fragmentation and climate‐driven isolation.

pmc-13643836.title: Association between Daily Physical Activities and Clinical Knee Osteoarthritis: A Community-Based Study
pmc-13643836.creator: Rudy Hidayat, Fara Fauzia, Faisal Parlindungan, Suryo Anggoro Kusumo Wibowo, Anna Ariane, Johanda Damanik, Abirianty Priandani Araminta, Jessica Audrey
pmc-13643836.description: Background:Osteoarthritis (OA) is a leading cause of disability, especially in the knee. The relationship between daily physical activities and knee OA remains unclear. This study aimed to examine the association between daily physical activities and knee OA in an Indonesian population.
